dedupe_keys.name: flexsim 3d simulation modelling and analysis software

description: FlexSim is 3D simulation modelling and analysis software, available since 1993 from FlexSim Software Products, for understanding and improving systems and processes by turning existing data into predictions. Users lay out and build models in a 3D environment, analyse them, and test what-if scenarios with built-in optimisation; FlexScript, a C-like language, gives access to hundreds of modelling commands, and an open architecture integrates with C++ for extensions. Industry pages show example models, and case studies describe its use; the company reports dozens of Fortune 500 users worldwide, and a healthcare edition exists. A free trial is offered after sign-up, with educational resources, forums and a user manual; commercial prices are not shown on the pages read. Caveats: it is proprietary, and model quality depends on the input data and the modeller. For simulation it runs discrete-event models of manufacturing lines, warehouses, logistics and service processes for capacity planning, disruption and what-if studies. Related catalogue records include Siemens Plant Simulation and Simio.
